##Current shipping forecast##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Azores high stretches to the south of Britain, with a waving frontal zone over Scotland.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 occasionally 5, especially in east of area.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the east.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, patchy rain or drizzle at first and later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 occasionally 5, especially in the east, decreasing 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, perhaps moderate in the east at times.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, risk of patchy drizzle in places at first


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in any drizzle.
